measurementRules.rule: Whole accepted net product at the fixed gate; measure gross minus actual tare. Dry assay, nitrogen content and later delivered mass are companion bases, never substitute denominators.
Whole feed mass once. CH2O-equivalent assay is not free-HCHO species fraction or free-water mass. Retain actual hydrates/oligomers, stabilizer/methanol and carrier-water conventions independently.
The actual native AC flow uses this MJ property; convert measured kWh by 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ as an electrical unit conversion, without inferring fuel, combustion or a generation mix.

Record actual fluid mass and thermodynamic state on both sides. Heat/provider conversion needs measured compatible enthalpies and units; kg and MJ are not interchangeable. Do not purchase both mass steam and its embedded heat twice.

measurementRules.rule: One actual whole receiver transfer Qt includes all substrate, chemical and water components once. Model only evidenced non-overlapping cohort treatment demand A_c in compatible provider units / original Q_c; Qt/Q_c is analytical only. Unknown shares stay unresolved.

Species and medium are explicit; preserve analytical-equivalent conversions, gas conditions and non-detect bounds. Total VOC/PM/COD is not a species mass or permission to assign all residue to hexamine.

calculationRules.rule: Q = sum of whole net m_e over unique first-acceptance events at the fixed gate; retain original event/cohort and moisture basis once. Loops and returns create no new event.

Modeled row exchange = its evidenced non-overlapping attributable numerator / positive original cohort Q_c. Waste-treatment numerator is compatible A_c or a separately assigned vector, not full shared Qt for every cohort. Unknown basis leaves raw totals and unresolved results.
calculationRules.output: row original unit per 1 kg reference flow

calculationRules.rule: Q0 = disjoint net remaining deliveries + all actual onsite accepted states + irreversible losses + other terminal dispositions on original acceptance basis, separately excluding later external additions; do not restore loss into survivors and count it again.

Physical opening + external inputs = physical closing + external outputs with actual reaction/speciation and equal internal links; separately reconcile opening own-WIP vectors + disjoint new vectors = closing carried + terminal attributed vectors. Allocation never creates physical closure.

Convert actual method result to its documented as-received/dried/CH2O-equivalent convention only; do not mix IS nonaqueous and JECFA decomposition equivalences, infer free water from nominal assay, or replace whole-product Q by analyte mass.

Electrical MJ = measured kWh × 3.6. Steam/cooling heat = measured mass × compatible actual enthalpy difference with declared sign/state; match provider units explicitly, without a default factor or duplicate mass-and-heat burden.

Species load = integral of actual compatible concentration × gas flow × time, with explicit species/equivalent and unit conversion. Preserve carrier moisture and actual post-control/fugitive coverage; unknown conversion is unresolved.

measurementRules.rule: 固定门的完整验收净产品，以总质量减实际皮重计量。干基含量、氮含量及后续交付质量是伴随基准，不能替代分母。
完整进料质量仅计一次。CH2O等效含量不是游离HCHO物种分数或游离水质量；实际水合物/低聚物、稳定剂/甲醇及载水约定须独立保留。
实际原生交流电流采用该MJ属性；实测千瓦时按1 kWh = 3.6 MJ作电气单位换算，不推断燃料、燃烧或发电组合。
两侧均记录实际流体质量及热力学状态。热量/供应方换算须实测兼容焓值与单位；千克和MJ不能互换，不重复购入质量蒸汽及其嵌入热量。

明确物种及环境介质，保留分析等效量换算、气体条件及未检出界限。总VOC/PM/COD不是物种质量，不能据此把全部残余归为六亚甲基四胺。

calculationRules.rule: Q = 固定门唯一首次验收事件完整净m_e之和，原事件/批群及水分基准仅保留一次，循环及退货不形成新事件。
行模型交换 = 有据且不重叠归属分子 / 正原批群Q_c。废物处理分子是兼容A_c或独立归属向量，不能对每个批群使用全部共享Qt。基准未知时保留原始总量及未解决结果。
calculationRules.output: 本行原单位/每1千克参考流

calculationRules.rule: Q0 = 原验收基准的互斥净剩余交付 + 全部实际场内验收状态 + 不可逆损失 + 其他终端处置，后续外部新增另行排除；不得把损失恢复进幸存量后再次计损。
物理期初 + 外部输入 = 物理期末 + 外部输出，保留实际反应/物种及等量内部连接；另核对期初自有在制品向量 + 不重叠新向量 = 期末结转 + 终端归属向量。分配不能创造物理闭合。
仅按实际方法记录换算收到/干燥/CH2O等效约定，不混用IS非水法与JECFA分解法当量，不从名义含量推游离水，不以分析物质量替代完整产品Q。
电气MJ = 实测千瓦时 × 3.6。蒸汽/冷却热 = 实测质量 × 兼容实际焓差，并声明符号/状态；明确匹配供应方单位，不设默认因子或重复质量/热负荷。
物种负荷 = 实际兼容浓度 × 气流量 × 时间的积分，明确物种/等效量及单位换算。保留载气水分和实际控制后/无组织覆盖，未知换算保持未解决。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 建立完整真实且具源据的汽提/CatOx生产单元，不用泛化处置代理。匹配实际成对物理界面及全部生产单元清单/负荷，跨全部相态/出口/批群的联合需求只计一次，内部流仅在合并时抵消。不声称已有合格数据集，缺实际生产单元/相态/基质/基准妨碍完整研究使用。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 核对完整产品/组分身份、实际相态/组成/CAS/路线、属性/单位组及供应方基准；源端分类或污染别名不能独立证明匹配。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原生记录、实际牌号及兼容供应方

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 独立核对实际总质量/C/H/N/O、反应物种及水约定，不设理论收率或方程产水默认。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 实际分析/物种、反应程度、相态及库存记录

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留唯一门Q、全部后续状态、一次自有/供应方继承向量及完整失败/返工/待机时段。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 验收谱系、物理及不重叠负荷账

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 实际完整接收方/供应方总量仅一次，已知物理出处独立于有据模型A_c/Q_c。未知共享/单位兼容未解决，不设寿命/份额/抵扣默认。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整混合物磅单、组分库存、实际服务历史及供应方单位

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 采用实际完整适用程序、取样、回收/空白/校准及不确定性。IS/JECFA不证明食品批准、全部工业杂质或烟气/废水方法。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 方法版本、实际基质验证及实验室质控

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 披露未解决输入/供应方/物种及全部测量/路径缺口，方法/模式成功不构成科学研究批准。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 连续场址记录及明确完整性评估
